modelPolicy.blockedFallback: elevenlabs-sfx is available but disallowed by user requirement
modelPolicy.currentToolFinding: Gemini TTS and Google Lyria music are available; no Gemini SFX/soundscape-specific model is exposed in the current tool list.
modelPolicy.pilotGate: Generate one Lyria 3 Clip pilot only after confirming we accept music-model soundscape output for non-musical ambience. If the pilot contains melody, vocals, beat, or song structure, stop and wait for a Gemini soundscape/SFX-capable model.
modelPolicy.currentDecision: Use free real-source Mixkit nature recordings for the shipped V2 pack; generated candidates remain quarantine-only until they pass QC.
modelPolicy.legacyCafePolicy: The old cafe/social-noise family is not a visible V2 nature option; cafe ids normalize to forest for compatibility.

assetPolicy.looping: must feel seamless, no obvious start/end, no hard transient at the seam
assetPolicy.loudness: background ambience, quieter than UI feedback, no clipping, no harsh transients
assetPolicy.runtime: local bundled files under public/sounds/hyperfocus, preload none, user-started only
